title: SelectionToolsConfig
description: What the selection tools may do on this page, and the actions they offer.

enabled.description: False when the remote flag or the AI toggle is off, and on native's own sites: no toolbar shows and contextMenuOpened is not sent.

showToolbar.description: The user's setting for the toolbar. When false, no toolbar shows, but contextMenuOpened is still sent while enabled.

startCollapsed.description: Show the toolbar as the collapsed chip, expanding on hover. Defaults to false.

askAvailable.description: Whether the built-in Ask is offered. When false, the toolbar has no Ask button and actionRequested is never sent with "ask". Defaults to true.

userLanguage.description: The user's language as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. "fr-FR". Text in another language counts as foreign. Absent when enabled is false.

actions.description: Actions in the order they should appear. "Ask" is built in and must not be listed.

id.description: Sent back as actionId. Must not be "ask".

icon.description: A 16×16 glyph as filled paths, drawn in the toolbar's text colour. The default icon is used when absent.

selectionTypes.description: Selection types the action fits. Absent or empty fits every type.

editable.description: Only fits editable selections when true, only non-editable ones when false. Absent fits both.

condition.description: An extra requirement. Unknown conditions never match.

kind.description: "language" options are BCP 47 tags with the user's language first: text in another language runs with that first option, and the selection's own language is never offered.

d.description: SVG path data in a 16×16 box.
